changelog: - **The lines of a large diagram are drawn sooner.** A layout's routes are computed in short slices between which the page stays responsive. After any one step took longer than a slice, every later slice ran a single step: the MMO progression Template's 1,158 steps ran in 1,159 slices. A slice now takes another step whenever the last one still fits, as intended. On that Template the routing runs in 236 slices, finishes in about 1.7 s instead of 1.9 s, and the Template settles in about 3.3 s instead of 3.7 s. The longest slice is a little longer, 13 ms instead of 11 ms typically, at most 15 ms as measured. The other Templates take the same time as before, within what varies from one run to the next.
